subject: french

moments.title: Law on separation of Church and State
moments.body: The 1905 law establishes laicite, removing public funding for religion.
moments.takeaway: French secularism is a specific historical settlement.

moments.title: Headscarf law
moments.body: Conspicuous religious symbols, including the Islamic headscarf, are banned in state schools.
moments.takeaway: Laicite's interpretation has evolved with immigration.

moments.title: Burqa ban
moments.body: Full face coverings are banned in public space. The law is upheld by the European Court of Human Rights.
moments.takeaway: Religious dress became a battleground for republican identity.

now.title: Laicite today
now.body: Debates continue over the abaya in schools, public swimming and Catholic processions. Macron's 'separatism' law (2021) intensified controversy.
now.open_questions: How can laicite be both neutral and applied unevenly?

reflection: France's secularism is at once principle and battleground.
